title: Is World War 3 Coming? The Rapture, Iran, Bible Prophecy & Israel Explained! | Greg Laurie
summary: Pastor Greg Laurie on the Iran war, the Doomsday Clock, Bible prophecy, Israel and the rapture, urging faith over fear.

assertions.quote: Scientists have even moved the Doomsday Clock to just 85 seconds before midnight. By the way, that's the closest it's ever been

verdicts.note: The Bulletin set the clock at its closest ever setting in January 2026, though the clock is an expert judgment, not a measurement.

assertions.quote: some experts are warning that World War III may be closer than ever.

verdicts.note: Forecasters put great-power war well below even odds, and the Cuban missile crisis and 1983 were closer calls than anything on record since.

The Clock is at its closest-ever setting, but it measures global catastrophe from several technologies (including climate and biology), not the odds of a world war, so 'closest ever' does not transfer directly to world war.

assertions.quote: he says there's going to be wars and rumors of wars and nation arise against nation.

verdicts.note: Whether Revelation foretells a future war is a matter of religious interpretation, not evidence.

assertions.quote: The Book of Revelation unveils the events of the last days, which I believe we're moving toward.

verdicts.note: A matter of faith with no testable content.

assertions.quote: The Bible tells us that the final conflicts of humanity will center on Jerusalem.

verdicts.note: A prophetic reading, not a forecast that evidence can check.

assertions.quote: to look at a blood moon happening and thinking that fulfills Bible prophecy is misguided at best.
Hundreds of Americans have been killed by this Iranian regime through acts of terrorism including attacks on our soldiers through proxy organizations

verdicts.note: It includes 241 US service members in the 1983 Beirut bombing and about 600 deaths the Pentagon attributes to Iran-backed militias in Iraq.

assertions.quote: They've also threatened to wipe Israel off the map.

verdicts.note: Iranian leaders have repeatedly called for Israel's elimination, though the translation of the 2005 phrase is disputed.
